tools.name: draft_chase_email
tools.description: Draft a payment follow-up email for an overdue invoice. Returns subject + body. Does not send email — the user copies it to their own inbox.

tools.name: get_chase_tip
tools.description: Get a short chase-tone tip for how late an invoice is.

tools.name: recommend_template
tools.description: Recommend a free docstoc payment-reminder template for a given days-overdue stage, with a URL.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List docstoc free invoice follow-up email templates with URLs.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_templates · Public sink: draft_chase_email, list_templates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_templates · Public sink: draft_chase_email, list_templates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
